user_intent: Make low-level proof-writing decisions explicit for an AI reading the Manual: roles, hypotheses, binder scope, witness dependencies, logic, domains, equality and exact verification.
synthesis_gap: Most individual features already had S/O/F/P contracts. The missing layer was a nearby writing entry that connects the mathematical sentence, legal statement surface, available assumptions and exported conclusion.

publication.guide: Proof Process -> Basic decisions before writing a proof

forward_derivation: Fix mathematical carrier, quantifiers, dependencies and target
Choose value, definition, fact or action
Activate goal binders/premises on a legal proof surface
Use a verified condition or interface in its supported direction
Supply or extract witnesses with the correct dependence
Publish only the verified result and replay the whole source

core_contracts.definition_vs_truth: Concrete prop supplies a condition; an arbitrary real need not satisfy it. Abstract signatures supply no global instances.
core_contracts.forall_vs_claim: A forall lists facts; explicit by def/witness/obtain are statements. A claim permits those actions with active goal binders and hypotheses.
core_contracts.scope: Active names cannot be rebound; goal parameters and helper names do not escape a local claim.
core_contracts.existence: Witness proves an existence body; obtain verifies its source and extracts a value. Existing numeric witness does not prove uniqueness.
core_contracts.logic: P=>Q requires P and does not imply Q=>P. An or fact does not select a branch; exhaustive cases can establish one shared consequence.
core_contracts.generality: A numerical instance does not establish a symbolic universal. A fixed outer value is not an input-dependent witness.
core_contracts.domains: Natural subtraction needs its nonnegative/positive condition; real exact rational values differ from finite decimal approximations.
core_contracts.equality: Element, subset, set equality and full-domain function equality have distinct obligations.

current_source_observation.forall_conclusions: The inspected current verifier checks and stores each successful then-fact sequentially. The guide does not teach the obsolete blanket claim that conclusions can never help later conclusions. Bare forall still accepts factual syntax rather than proof commands.
